question: Who was named as the president of Shiv Sena (Shinde Group) during the party's national executive meeting in Mumbai in February 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Eknath Shinde**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Eknath Shinde was named as the president of Shiv Sena (Shinde Group) during the party's national executive meeting held in Mumbai in February 2023.
 
• He is the current Chief Minister of Maharashtra, having taken office on 30th June 2022.
 
• Eknath Shinde has been a prominent leader within the Shiv Sena party and has held various key positions before becoming the president of his faction.
 
• The national executive meeting where he was named president was held after the split in the Shiv Sena party, leading to the formation of the Shinde Group.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shiv Sena Split:**

 
 
• The Shiv Sena party experienced a significant split in 2022, leading to the formation of two factions: one led by Eknath Shinde and the other by Uddhav Thackeray.
 
• The split resulted from internal disagreements over the party's direction and alliances.
 
• The Election Commission of India is involved in adjudicating the legitimacy of the two factions.
 
 
 
• **Eknath Shinde's Political Career:**
 
 
• Eknath Shinde has been an active politician in Maharashtra for several decades.
 
• He has served as the Minister of Public Works (Public Undertakings) in the Government of Maharashtra.
 
• Shinde has a strong political base in the Thane district and has been elected multiple times to the Maharashtra Legislative Assembly.
 
 
 
• **Political Climate in Maharashtra:**
 
 
• Maharashtra has been a politically volatile state with frequent shifts in alliances and leadership.
 
• The formation of the Shinde government marked a significant shift in the state's political landscape.
 
• The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) extended support to Eknath Shinde's faction, influencing the power dynamics in the state.
 
 
 
• **Shiv Sena's Legacy:**
 
 
• Shiv Sena was founded by Bal Thackeray in 1966, with a focus on advocating for the rights of the Marathi-speaking population.
 
• The party has played a significant role in Maharashtra's politics, often adopting a regional and nationalist stance.
 
• The split and subsequent formation of factions have been pivotal moments in the party's history.
